sources.title: GitHub - cactus-compute/needle: 14MB foundation model for tiny devices ...
sources.snippet: Fine-tuning Needle fine-tunes with LoRA on the frozen base and merges the adapter at export, so a run is cheap and the tuned model is still a single .cact that runs on the same engine. The workflow is: (optionally) synthesize data, LoRA fine-tune, then build a tuned .cact.
